title: Estimated US chickenpox cases per year (millions)

source.name: Varicella surveillance and vaccination impact estimates
source.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC)

notes: Illustrative; pre-vaccine era case counts are CDC's widely cited national estimate of about 4 million cases per year. The varicella vaccine was licensed in 1995 and a routine second dose was added in 2006, driving the collapse in cases toward near-elimination levels by the late 2010s.
